Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly implements national-scale spatial modeling for Mexico, with the primary objective of predicting future land use/cover change (LUCC) under two distinct socioeconomic and climate scenarios—BAU and pessimistic. It uses quantitative transition matrices, projects LUCC to 2020, 2050, and 2080, and produces mapped outputs (Fig. 2). The study reports quantitative accuracy metrics (e.g., figure of merit = 94%, allocation/quantity disagreement, similarity index) and identifies hotspots of change. All core inclusion criteria are met: national scale, primary focus on LULC prediction, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with accuracy validation, and mapped projections. None of the exclusion criteria apply—it is not global, regional, species-focused, methodological without application, or single-scenario.)
